title: Neutral molecule calculations
action: Perform unrestricted Hartree-Fock geometry optimization with the 6-31G* basis set for neutral methionine, methionine sulfoxide, and methionine sulfone. Record the total electronic energies and dipole moments of each optimized structure.
description: Process step that runs the neutral-molecule calculations. The evidence file (neutral_results.json) contains total energies and dipole moments, which are consumed by downstream scored steps.

title: Protonated species calculations
action: For each compound, perform unrestricted Hartree-Fock geometry optimization with the 6-31G* basis set for all relevant protonated forms: methionine protonated at amino nitrogen, carboxyl oxygen, and sulfur; methionine sulfoxide protonated at amino nitrogen, carboxyl oxygen, and the SO oxygen; methionine sulfone protonated at amino nitrogen, carboxyl oxygen, and one of the SO2 oxygens. Record the total electronic energy for each optimized cation.
description: Process step that runs the protonated-form calculations. The evidence file stores the total energies, which are used by the proton-affinity scored step.

title: Proton affinity computation
action: Compute proton affinities (PA) as the difference between the neutral total energy and the protonated total energy for each site, using the energies recorded in steps 1 and 2. Output the values in kcal/mol.
description: Calculates all proton affinities from the computed total energies. This step is load-bearing because the PA values depend on the full quantum chemical calculations.
output_schema: JSON object with top-level keys 'methionine', 'methionine_sulfoxide', 'methionine_sulfone'. Each maps to an object containing site-specific keys ('N', 'O', 'S' for methionine; 'N', 'O', 'SO' for sulfoxide; 'N', 'O', 'SO2' for sulfone) and the corresponding proton affinity (float, kcal/mol).

title: Most favorable site determination
action: For each compound, identify the protonation site with the highest proton affinity from the values in proton_affinities.json. Output the site name (string) for each compound.
description: Determines the thermodynamically preferred protonation centre per compound as the one with the maximum PA.
output_schema: JSON object with keys 'methionine', 'methionine_sulfoxide', 'methionine_sulfone' mapping to a string: 'N', 'S', 'O', 'SO', or 'SO2'.

title: Dipole moment reporting
action: Extract the dipole moments of the neutral molecules from the results of step 1 and output them in Debye.
description: Reports the computed dipole moments of the three neutral compounds.
output_schema: JSON object with keys 'methionine', 'methionine_sulfoxide', 'methionine_sulfone' mapping to the dipole moment (float, Debye).
